title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Fit Guarantee: Remakes of Completed Work
content:
**Guarantee.** When the customer reports that completed Marlowe & Finch Alterations work does not fit as agreed, a remake is accepted free of charge, on these conditions:

1. **Window.** The remake is requested within the remake window after the pickup date. The window counts calendar days starting the day after the pickup date as day 1, and a request on the last day of the class's remake-window days is in time. The pickup date is the one recorded on the ticket concerned.
2. **Count.** The ticket's remake count must be below the class's maximum free remakes.
3. **Scope.** The remake corrects the agreed operations only: correction charges are waived as a remake at no charge, and any new operation the customer asks for is charged under the price list.
4. **Condition of the garment.** A garment worn, washed or altered elsewhere after pickup is not remade.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 14-day window)

| Request made | Day count after pickup | In time |
|---|---|---|
| The day after pickup | day 1 | yes |
| The 14th day after pickup | day 14 | yes (last day) |
| The 15th day after pickup | day 15 | no |

## Count, both sides (hypothetical maximum of 2)

- Remake count 1 on the ticket: 1 is below 2, so the count condition holds.
- Remake count 2 on the ticket: 2 is not below 2, so the count condition fails.

## Hypothetical illustration of scope

A hem taken up too short is corrected in a remake, and the customer also asks for the waist to be taken in. The hem correction is waived as a remake at no charge; taking in the waist is a new operation and is charged at the price list.
